Feature_Definition: Number of independent caller algorithms that called the candidate variant interval. Strongest positive predictor of true genomic CNVs.
Calculation_Method_and_Formula: Derived from SURVIVOR SUPP_VEC bitmask or Truvari MatchId cluster graph across caller VCFs: concordance = sum_{c} I(caller_c called variant)

Feature_Definition: Fraction of Guanine (G) and Cytosine (C) nucleotides across the candidate CNV interval. Primary penalty driver against extreme-GC capture dropouts and PCR amplification bias.
Calculation_Method_and_Formula: Extracted from reference genome (GRCh38.fa) using pysam: (G + C) / (A + C + G + T) across the [start, end) interval excluding Ns

Feature_Definition: Number of captured exon target intervals overlapping the candidate variant. High probe counts reinforce genuine multi-exon CNVs.
Calculation_Method_and_Formula: Interval intersection between candidate interval [start, end) and capture target BED file via binary search: count of overlapping bait intervals

Feature_Definition: Normalized log2 copy-ratio displacement away from diploid expectation (log2(1.0) = 0.0). Positive for duplications (~+0.58), negative for heterozygous deletions (~-1.0).
Calculation_Method_and_Formula: Coalesced from CNVkit INFO/log2 or probe-level BAM baseline: mean(log2(probe_depth / flank_baseline)) across CNV probes

Feature_Definition: Local coverage step contrast between the CNV interval and immediate flanking probes, robust against whole-exome sequencing depth shifts.
Calculation_Method_and_Formula: l2r_mean_CNV - mean(l2r_flank) computed over the 20 immediate flanking probes outside the CNV interval

Feature_Definition: Normalized Bayesian posterior evidence score from GATK-gCNV hierarchical model.
Calculation_Method_and_Formula: Extracted from GATK-gCNV VCF QUAL field and transformed to universal [0, 1000] scale: min(1000, 10 * Q_GATK)

Feature_Definition: Physical genomic length of the candidate copy number alteration in base pairs. Filters stochastic single-point read-depth noise.
Calculation_Method_and_Formula: stop - pos coordinate difference from merged VCF record

Feature_Definition: Variance of normalized log2 copy ratios across probes within the CNV segment. High variance penalizes irregular hybridization artifacts.
Calculation_Method_and_Formula: Sample variance of probe-level log2 ratios within the CNV: sum((l2r_i - l2r_mean)^2) / (N - 1)

Feature_Definition: Normalized quality score from CANOES negative binomial hidden Markov model. High specificity for focal deletions.
Calculation_Method_and_Formula: Quantile-normalized log-likelihood score from CANOES transformed to universal [0, 1000] scale via normalise_cnv_caller_quality_scores.py

Feature_Definition: Binary penalty flag indicating high risk of ambiguous short-read alignment, repetitive elements, or segmental duplications.
Calculation_Method_and_Formula: Evaluated against 100-mer mappability BigWig/BED: 1 if interval mean mappability < 0.80, else 0

Feature_Definition: Statistical weight reflecting probe-level reliability in CNVkit. Higher values denote low-variance, confident target capture.
Calculation_Method_and_Formula: Extracted from CNVkit VCF INFO/weight or precomputed bin coverage variance and GC-correction weights

Feature_Definition: Normalized Bayes Factor (BF) from ExomeDepth beta-binomial likelihood model. Rescues rare heterozygous focal variants.
Calculation_Method_and_Formula: Extracted from ExomeDepth INFO/BF and mapped to universal [0, 1000] scale: min(1000, 10 * BF)

Feature_Definition: Absolute deviation of target GC content from optimal exome baseline (50%). Linearizes the inverted U-shaped hybrid-capture efficiency curve.
Calculation_Method_and_Formula: abs(gc_content - 0.50) computed in bin/feature_extraction.py

Feature_Definition: Ratio of mean read depth in the candidate CNV interval relative to flanking background baseline.
Calculation_Method_and_Formula: mean_depth(CNV) / mean_depth(flank 500 bp) calculated from BAM/CRAM pileup or derived from 2^log2_ratio

Feature_Definition: Target probe packaging density per kilobase of genomic sequence. Differentiates densely covered exons from sparse intronic intervals.
Calculation_Method_and_Formula: n_probes / (cnv_size / 1000)

Feature_Definition: Arithmetic mean of normalized quality scores across all callers endorsing the candidate call.
Calculation_Method_and_Formula: mean(qual_norm_c) for all callers c supporting the variant; NaN handled natively by CatBoost via nan_mode='Min'

Feature_Definition: Proportion of active callers in the cohort pipeline endorsing the candidate variant.
Calculation_Method_and_Formula: concordance / 6.0 (total active open-source callers in pipeline)

Feature_Definition: Ratio of target capture length to estimated fragment footprint. Penalizes unsequenced intronic bait overhangs.
Calculation_Method_and_Formula: cnv_size / (cnv_size + 300) assuming standard 300 bp library insert size

Feature_Definition: Normalized PCA Z-score quality metric from XHMM hidden Markov model.
Calculation_Method_and_Formula: Extracted from XHMM INFO/RD and QUAL, transformed to universal [0, 1000] scale via normalise_cnv_caller_quality_scores.py

Feature_Definition: Normalized coverage HMM quality score from CLAMMS window-scaled coverage model.
Calculation_Method_and_Formula: Extracted from CLAMMS QUAL field and transformed to universal [0, 1000] scale

Feature_Definition: Ordinal categorical size bin (1-12) encoding non-linear genomic scale matching CN-Learn scheme.
Integer encoding for chromosome context.
Calculation_Method_and_Formula: Autosomes 1-22 map to integers 1-22, X maps to 23, Y maps to 24, all other contigs map to 0

Feature_Definition: Binary variant classification indicator.
Calculation_Method_and_Formula: 1 for Duplications (DUP), 0 for Deletions (DEL) or other variants from VCF ALT/SVTYPE

Feature_Definition: Maximum normalized quality score across all supporting callers.
Calculation_Method_and_Formula: max(qual_norm_c) across agreeing callers c

Feature_Definition: Binary indicator for CANOES caller support.
Calculation_Method_and_Formula: 1 if CANOES called the variant, else 0

Feature_Definition: Binary indicator for CLAMMS caller support.
Calculation_Method_and_Formula: 1 if CLAMMS called the variant, else 0

Feature_Definition: Binary indicator for CNVkit caller support.
Calculation_Method_and_Formula: 1 if CNVkit called the variant, else 0

Feature_Definition: Binary indicator for ExomeDepth caller support.
Calculation_Method_and_Formula: 1 if ExomeDepth called the variant, else 0

Feature_Definition: Binary indicator for GATK-gCNV caller support.
Calculation_Method_and_Formula: 1 if GATK-gCNV called the variant, else 0

Feature_Definition: Binary indicator for XHMM caller support.
Calculation_Method_and_Formula: 1 if XHMM called the variant, else 0

Feature_Definition: Binary indicator for DRAGEN commercial benchmark caller support.
Calculation_Method_and_Formula: 1 if DRAGEN called the variant, else 0

Feature_Definition: Number of capture probes in flanking regions within half the CNV length on either side.
Calculation_Method_and_Formula: Count of BED probes in [start - flank, start) and [end, end + flank) where flank = cnv_size / 2

Feature_Definition: Mean continuous mappability score across the candidate interval.
Calculation_Method_and_Formula: Length-weighted average of 100-mer mappability track scores across [start, end)

Feature_Definition: Binary flag for extreme GC content.
Calculation_Method_and_Formula: 1 if gc_content < 0.32 or > 0.68, else 0

Feature_Definition: Total split reads supporting breakpoint junctions.
Calculation_Method_and_Formula: Extracted from SvABA structural variant junction calls or CRAM split-read evidence

Feature_Definition: Shannon entropy of split-read start/stop coordinates around boundaries.
Calculation_Method_and_Formula: Shannon entropy of read alignment split positions: -sum(p_i * log2(p_i))

Feature_Definition: Binary indicator for split reads supporting both boundaries.
Calculation_Method_and_Formula: 1 if split reads independently anchor both 5' and 3' breakpoints, else 0

Feature_Definition: Base-pair exact breakpoint resolution indicator. Intentionally excluded from CatBoost training to prevent intronic dropout bias in short-read WES.
Calculation_Method_and_Formula: 1 if VCF INFO/PRECISE is present, else 0

Feature_Definition: SV refinement status indicator. Intentionally excluded from CatBoost training to maintain uniform exome-wide calibration.
Calculation_Method_and_Formula: 1 if VCF INFO/SV_REFINED is present, else 0
